title: Filipino-Style Charred Bihon Noodle Stir-Fry
description: A flavorful stir-fry dish made with charred bihon noodles, a variety of vegetables, and a hint of Filipino spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and onion, and stir-fry until the onion is translucent.
Add the bell pepper and mushrooms, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the charred bihon noodles, light soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the green onions and stir-fry for another minute.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
